"""
lru_cache.py

A thread-safe LRU cache with TTL (time-to-live) expiry.

Features:
    - Thread-safe via a re-entrant lock (RLock), so methods may call
      other locked methods internally.
    - LRU eviction: least-recently-used entries are evicted first when
      the cache exceeds its maximum size.
    - TTL expiry: entries expire after a configurable number of seconds.
      Expired entries are purged lazily on access and eagerly on demand.
    - Full type hints and docstrings.
    - Optional per-entry TTL override at set-time.

Classes:
    LRUCache - the cache itself.
    CacheEntry - internal record for a single cached value.

Example:
    >>> cache = LRUCache(max_size=2, default_ttl=60)
    >>> cache.set("a", 1)
    >>> cache.get("a")
    1
    >>> import time
    >>> cache.set("b", 2, ttl=0.1)
    >>> time.sleep(0.2)
    >>> cache.get("b") is None
    True
